parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The end time of the query, in milliseconds.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region where the data management center of threat detection and response is located. Select the management center based on the region of your assets. Valid values:
- cn-hangzhou: the asset belongs to the Chinese mainland or Hong Kong (China).
- ap-southeast-1: the asset belongs to a region outside China.

parameters.name: RoleFor
parameters.description: The ID of the user to which the administrator switches the view.

parameters.name: RoleType
parameters.description:
The view type. Valid values:

- 0: the view of the current Alibaba Cloud account.
- 1: the view of all accounts in the enterprise.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The start time of the query, in milliseconds.
